task.title: HealthKit Cardio graduation readiness — prepared, not activated

result.summary: Claude prepared (did not execute) the full Cardio graduation package: re-verified the atomic policy-replacement runner and bounded deferred-reconciliation runner are safe and compatible with the not-yet-deployed workout-type-fidelity Server candidate; re-confirmed via a fresh, widened, read-only production inventory that the deferred-Cardio backlog is still exactly 4 (2 walks Sep23, 2 walks Sep24), none carrying recoverable Indoor/Outdoor metadata; built exact future dry-run command packages for both the policy widening and the per-observation reconciliation; defined Activity-accounting pre/post invariants and a no-double-count guard; wrote a Founder real-device acceptance checklist; and defined a 10-gate execution sequence, each gate its own separate future authorization. A fresh-context adversarial review (independent test re-run + source ground-truthing) returned APPROVE WITH NOTES: two real findings -- the reconciliation runner's collection-wide drift fence means the 4 entries must be dry-run/applied strictly serially, never batched; and this report's own manifest checksum has no executable implementation and is non-authoritative, superseded by the runner's own built-in digest fencing -- both were corrected in the published report before finalizing. No code changes were needed. Nothing was deployed, uploaded, activated, or mutated.

tests.summary: Fresh re-run: HealthKitActivationPolicyRunner.test.js + HealthKitDeferredWorkoutReconciliationRunner.test.js -> 51/51 passed, independently reconfirmed a second time by the fresh-context reviewer. No new tests were needed -- the required 'preserves specific type when present, generic when absent' regression and all Activity-accounting invariants were confirmed already present and green.

review.summary: Fresh-context adversarial review of the complete readiness package (design-level; no code changed to review as a diff). Verdict: APPROVE WITH NOTES. Independently ground-truthed every Part A/E/F claim against real source with line citations and independently re-ran the cited tests rather than trusting the report. Two genuine findings, both incorporated before publishing: (1) Gates 7/8 cannot be run as a single batched dry-run-all/apply-all pass -- the reconciliation runner's drift fence hashes the full observation/canonical-workout collections, so entries must be dry-run and applied strictly serially, one at a time; (2) this report's own SHA-256 manifest checksum has no corresponding script in buildHealthKitPayload.mjs and cannot be mechanically reproduced -- it is now explicitly scoped as a non-authoritative, human-readable preparation artifact only, with the runner's own built-in per-observation digest/idempotency fencing as the real execution-time drift protection. No rejection-level defect found; gate ordering independently confirmed correct.

zero_write_audit.summary: Every production interaction in this task was bounded and read-only: a widened (2026-09-22 through 2026-09-27) fresh inventory read confirming the deferred-Cardio backlog is still exactly 4 with no new arrivals, plus a safe zero-write 'digest discovery via deliberate refusal' read of the live policy digest. No write of any kind was attempted or reached.

decisions_required: Gate 1: Authorize deployment of Server type-fidelity candidate c58dcca97e7b1a32c829485b7f8dc3d8fa5bb5a5, unless superseded by a clean combined candidate with Midweek's work.
Gate 2: Authorize installing/accepting a combined Native build containing Strength-fix candidate 6a108d25e2a05b63c9561be3aeb9952f4e9dafe1.
Gate 4/5: After Gates 1-3, authorize a dry-run then separately authorize apply of the atomic policy-replacement tooling (Strength-only -> [cardio, strength]).

Gate 7/8: After Gate 6, authorize -- per entry, strictly serially, not batched -- a dry-run then separately authorize apply of the deferred-Cardio-reconciliation runner for each of the 4 known identities.
unexpected_findings: The deferred-Cardio backlog was re-verified fresh rather than assumed: still exactly 4, no new cardio-family observations have arrived in production since Sep24, confirmed via a widened read window through Sep27.

The two Sep23 deferred observations were recorded under America/Los_Angeles while the two Sep24 observations were recorded under America/Chicago -- a genuine device/location timezone difference between the two days, not a data inconsistency.

The fresh-context reviewer found that the reconciliation runner's drift fence is collection-wide (not per-observation only), which silently invalidates a naive 'dry-run all 4, then apply all 4' execution plan -- corrected in this report to a strictly serial per-entry sequence before publishing.

The fresh-context reviewer found this report's own bespoke manifest-checksum scheme has no corresponding executable tooling and cannot be mechanically reproduced at execution time -- rescoped in this report to a non-authoritative preparation artifact, with the runner's own tested digest fencing identified as the real execution-time protection.
backlog: Gate 2: fold Native 6a108d25 into the next consolidated release candidate with Midweek's work (own authorization, separate task).
Gate 3: refresh the bounded deferred-Cardio inventory and live policy digest immediately before activation.

Gates 4-9: dry-run/apply the policy replacement, then strictly-serial per-entry dry-run/apply of deferred-Cardio reconciliation for all 4 identities, each its own authorization, verified by pre/post read-only audits.
Gate 10: Founder real-device acceptance per the prepared checklist.
Strategic-evidence eligibility for Cardio remains a later, separate, not-yet-started project.
recommended_next_step: Claude should await Founder direction on Gate 1 (Server deployment of c58dcca9) and Gate 2 (Native candidate 6a108d25 reconciliation into the next consolidated build). No further Cardio-graduation preparation work is needed until those two are live/installed -- the remaining Gates 3-10 are fully specified in the published report and require only their own separate authorizations at that time, per-entry-serial for the reconciliation gates specifically.
